about: What follows a command runs after every command a visitor makes, nearest first: the lamp she carries, the room she stands in, then the world. Walking into the falls reads the falls before its roar; a refused command is followed by nothing; a lamp set down, or shut in the tin she carries, follows nobody. Each command of a line is followed on its own, and `look` reads the roar before the room.
